p: Josh Johnson, not Carson Beck, will start at QB for Arizona on Sunday vs. Kansas City.
Beck's back spasms put his second start in doubt, so avoid him in fantasy lineups unless he is confirmed active and starting.
Beck remains the starting quarterback against Kansas City, with Froholdt possibly back at center.
The rookie QB has the coach's full confidence and may get his center back, which helps his floor in a tough matchup.
